content.title: Why wasn't Sean Penn at the Oscars? Winner didn't show
content.text: POP-CULTUREWhy wasn't Sean Penn at the Oscars? Winner didn't show Cory WoodroofFor The WinUpdated March 16, 2026, 12:08 a.m. ETPlayUnmute0:00/0:43Full screenKeep WatchingVeteran actor Sean Penn won his third Oscar on Sunday night in Hollywood for his villainous turn as Col. Steven J. Lockjaw in Paul Thomas Anderson's One Battle After Another.However, Penn was not in attendance to accept his Best Supporting Actor Oscar. Where was he?The New York Times shared that Penn was in Europe for a planned trip to Ukraine at the same time as this year's ceremony.Why didn't he attend? Penn has been vocal about his support for Ukraine during the war, so he may have felt it more important to be there. It's also very possible Penn just did not want to attend the ceremony.He was not present at the Actor Awards earlier this month, nor did he attend the BAFTAs in February.
